LESSON 28 / ADDITIONAL INTERVIEW CONCEPT
Void elements and boolean attributes

Void elements cannot contain children or have end tags in HTML. A boolean attribute is true when
present, regardless of its written value.
Void elements වලට children Jහතෝ closing tag නුහු. Boolean attribute එකෙකේ තිJයෙනවා නම් ඒකෙ true. disabled="false" දුන්නත් disabled Jවනවා.
A form has an image, line break and a disabled button.

Void elements · Boolean attributes · · disabled="false" ·
· Button disabled ·

Read the diagram: Void tags stand alone; a present boolean attribute enables the state. Remove
disabled to enable the control.
Expected result: The checkbox is checked; the Save button is disabled.
Interview question: Does disabled="false" enable a button?
Answer: No. The presence of disabled makes it disabled. Remove the attribute.
Remember: Void = no children. Boolean = presence.
Practice: Create a checked checkbox and an enabled button.
